purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer/service evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Punjab PULSE exposes a Chiniot cadastral-map layer and the official PULSE survey viewer includes Chiniot. The current PULSE ArcGIS service rejected anonymous REST metadata/query requests with HTTP 499 Token Required, and the hierarchy API rejected anonymous access with HTTP 401 Bearer authentication required. No complete safe parcel polygon was obtained.
registryAssessment: Punjab PULSE/PLRA are the relevant provincial land-record and cadastral/map custodians evidenced by the official viewers and PLRA site. Chiniot district government pages evidence local land-record service context. This is custodian/map evidence, not open citywide parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official PULSE LIS viewer shell lists Cadastral Maps and explicitly includes Chiniot; its source configuration names the cadastral MapServer.
Official PULSE map-QC viewer shell lists Chiniot and exposes parcel survey controls, download controls, and a public viewer route.
Official Punjab Land Records Authority site describes Punjab digital land records and GIS-linked records/services.
Official Chiniot district services page lists issuance of Fard through e-Khidmat, providing local land-record service context.
Official Chiniot district profile supplies district land statistics; it is contextual and not parcel geometry.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Public HTML/JavaScript PULSE viewer using ArcGIS REST/MapServer and a separate ASP.NET parcel hierarchy API.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: ArcGIS service URLs were exposed in current public JavaScript, but metadata requests were rejected before schema/CRS could be read. PULSE parcel UI code references geomWKT, parcelId, parcelNo, subParcelNo, and mauzaId; these were not accepted as verified native schema because no response was obtained.
viewerConfiguration.sourceFieldMapping: No source-field mapping retained; UI field names are observational only and no parcel response was obtained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous parcel response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: Bounded metadata, layer, and small attribute-only ArcGIS query attempted; all were token-gated before any feature response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Punjab PULSE/PLRA cadastral and parcel-survey channels, including Chiniot.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous complete-polygon feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: Exact PULSE authentication policy, parcel query syntax, native identity field, service schema/CRS, and Chiniot city coverage remain unverified. HTTP 401/499, login walls, or exact-point misses are not evidence of no cadastral records.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous ID-plus-geometry response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
